title: BGS Directory of Mines and Quarries — Supplier Graph
$comment: Schema version 1.2 — updated to strictly align with SOP-DS-002 v1.1 (effective June 4, 2026). Changes from v1: (1) industry_sector now constrained to SOP §4.3 enum; (2) site.site_type now constrained to SOP §5.2 v1.1 extended enum; (3) data_completeness_flags values now constrained to SOP §5.5 enum ('manual_only' | 'api_only').

supplier_id.$comment: Always null during extraction — assigned by load_to_neo4j.py. SOP §5.1.

duns_number.$comment: null — not in BGS DMQ; may be resolved post-extraction via D&B lookup. SOP §5.1.

company_name.$comment: Copied exactly as printed in DMQ. Do not abbreviate or expand. SOP §5.1.

canonical_name.$comment: Lowercase, spaces to hyphens, & to 'and', remove remaining punctuation, keep ltd/plc/llp/uk/group. SOP §7.2. Pattern enforces lowercase-hyphenated form.

headquarters_location.$comment: Format: 'City, Country'. e.g. 'Buxton, United Kingdom'. null if operator address absent. SOP §5.1, §10.

website.$comment: null from DMQ alone. May be populated post-extraction via web search. SOP §5.1.

company_description.$comment: null from DMQ alone. Optionally populated with brief operator summary from public sources. SOP §5.1.

industry_sector.$comment: FIX (was unconstrained string): Must match SOP §4.3 table exactly. Derived from primary commodity type. Five additional sectors added in SOP v1.1: recycled aggregates, peat, clay/shale (→ industrial minerals), basalt NI (→ construction minerals), igneous & metamorphic rock (→ construction minerals).

supply_chain_tier.$comment: 1 = extraction/peat (default for quarry, mine, pit, brine well, peat workings). 2 = handling/processing/recycling/wharf/spoil heap. 3 = distributor (rare). SOP §4.2.

typical_lead_time_days.$comment: Always null — not stated in DMQ. SOP §5.1.

manufacturing_sites.$comment: One entry per physical mine/quarry/site operated by this company. SOP §5.2.

certification_references.$comment: Empty array [] — not in DMQ. SOP §5.1.

regulation_references.$comment: Empty array [] — not in DMQ. SOP §5.1.

products_offered.$comment: One entry per site per commodity per end use. Secondary commodities get their own entries. SOP §5.3, Rule 2.

is_verified.$comment: Always false from scraper — set to true only after human reviewer independently verifies. Rule 6, SOP §5.1.

data_completeness_flags.$comment: FIX (was additionalProperties: string with no value constraint): SOP §5.5 defines exactly five flags with exactly two permitted values. review_score=manual_only, defect_rate_ppm=manual_only, on_time_delivery_rate=manual_only, pricing=api_only, inventory_levels=api_only. No other keys or values are permitted.

sources.$comment: At least one tier1 BGS DMQ entry required. SOP §5.4.

location.$comment: Format: '{Site Name} ({OS Grid Ref})'. e.g. 'Tunstead Quarry (SK089748)'. If site name missing, use 'Unnamed Site ({Grid Ref})'. SOP §5.2, §10.

country.$comment: Inferred from BGS region code. CSCT/NSCT/SSCT → Scotland; NIR → Northern Ireland; NWLS/SWLS → Wales; CHA → Channel Islands; IOM → Isle of Man; all others → England. SOP §5.2.

site_type.$comment: FIX (was unconstrained string): Must use one of the 12 permitted values from SOP §5.2 v1.1 extended list. Original schema had no enum — this allows invalid values to pass validation. Infer from site name and DMQ section heading per SOP §5.2 and §10 edge cases.

raw.$comment: REQUIRED. Full verbatim DMQ site record text including MPA, end use, and formation. Never paraphrase. Rule 3.

product_name.$comment: Commodity name in Title Case. e.g. 'Limestone', 'Silica Sand'. For graded variants, keep base commodity name — do NOT create a separate product_name for graded variants. SOP §5.3, §10.

grade.$comment: End use as grade/variant. e.g. 'Aggregate', 'Chemical', 'Cement raw material'. Graded variants use grade='Graded'. SOP §5.3.

product_id.$comment: Format: '{GridRef}_{CommodityAbbrev}'. Secondary commodities use a different suffix. Multiple end uses use different suffixes (e.g. _LS_AGG vs _LS_CEM). Must be unique per site-commodity-grade combination. SOP §5.3.

category.$comment: BGS commodity section heading in ALL CAPS. e.g. 'LIMESTONE', 'SILICA SAND', 'FLUORSPAR'. SOP §5.3.

source_url.$comment: Always the BGS DMQ 2020 download page: https://www.bgs.ac.uk/mineralsuk/download/directory-of-mines-and-quarries-2020/ — never any other URL. Rule 5.

datasheet_url.$comment: Always null — PDFs are publication-level, not product-level. SOP §5.3.

cross_graph_material_id.$comment: Always null during extraction — populated post-load by the ID resolver. SOP §5.3.

source_name.$comment: For BGS DMQ records: 'BGS Directory of Mines and Quarries 2020, 11th Edition'. SOP §5.4.

source_url.$comment: Always the BGS DMQ 2020 download page URL. Rule 5.

tier.$comment: BGS DMQ is always tier1 (government/official source). SOP §5.4.
